messages:
mira chen: Hey team — Terraform plan for scale-up of gpu-pool-inference-02 is blocked by Conftest/OPA during our freeze window. We need to add 4 DGX nodes to handle a sudden capacity spike for a customer. Plan output attached.

deploy-bot: :warning: Plan failed policy check: 'opa/prevent-pool-changes-in-freeze' => violation at modules/gpu_pool/main.tf:45

ian lee: link to the failing rule?

mira chen: https://git.redwood/infra/policies/opa/prevent-pool-changes-in-freeze.rego — it blocks any changes to gpu pools between 23:00-06:00 PT unless there's an approved exception. We don't have an exception yet.

alex rivas: Why can't we do a rolling canary in the same pool instead of resizing? Is burst capacity not available?

mira chen: Burst was exhausted this morning. Customer traffic is sustained, not a short spike. Canary won't help — we need raw capacity added to keep latencies under SLO.

sam (ops-oncall): @mira can you paste the minimal tf diff and the risk mitigation steps? I'll triage.

mira chen: Sure — diff snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "inference_02" {
  size = 12 # was 8
  autoscaling { min = 8; max = 24 }
  labels = { critical_customer = "true", change_request = "CR-4521" }
}
```
Risk mitigations: new nodes in separate AZ, health checks with canary traffic to 10% initially, immediate rollback playbook, and 30m paired monitoring from SRE.

sam (ops-oncall): Ok. This fits emergency criteria but per policy we need a documented approver from Oncall + infra lead signoff. I can approve for the immediate window if infra lead + security ack within 30m.

security-bot: Heads-up: any manual override must pass audit logs to KMS and include justification in the PR body per compliance.

ian lee: @alex @mira @sam i suggest we create a temporary Conftest exemption tag instead of changing the policy. Add `exemptions = ["ops-emergency:CR-4521"]` to the pipeline metadata and gate it behind a required two-person approval in GitHub PR. That keeps policy intact but allows this change.

alex rivas: Agree — two approvers + oncall ack + tag sounds good. Also add post-deploy regression evals in Optimize for token cost.

mira chen: I'll open the PR with the exemption tag, include the diff and rollback runbook, and ping infra leads. PR link coming in 2m.

mira chen: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/1789 — title: "CR-4521: emergency add 4 nodes to gpu-pool-inference-02 (freeze window exception)"

sam (ops-oncall): I approve for immediate apply, pending infra lead or @ian second approval. I'll run apply once we have two approvals and update incident channel. :white_check_mark:

ian lee: Approved. Please ensure the pipeline prints the exemption tag and the Conftest audit log key.

security-bot: Noted. Will verify logs post-apply.

mira chen: Applying now with `TF_VAR_exemptions=ops-emergency:CR-4521` and `make infra-apply`. I'll watch health and post back in 15m.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Apply started by mira chen at 1841205660 — plan/apply logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5423

mira chen: Apply succeeded. New pool size 12. Initial canary traffic routed. Latency looks stable at +0.6% vs baseline.

sam (ops-oncall): Thanks. Leaving this open until post-deploy checks complete in 30m. Filing follow-up to formalize emergency-exemption flow in policy repo.

ian lee: Action item: infra to add a documented 'emergency-exemption' workflow to OPA/Conftest docs + add a short-lived ticket requirement (CR id) for traceability. I'll own the PR.

mira chen: Great — I'll close CR-4521 after 48h if stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
